title: Login & Submission Issue ("Connection to the server was lost")

latest.raw:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to submit my contribution for the hackathon track2, but I'm running into a persistent authentication issue.

Even though I am logged into Hugging Face, clicking the login/sign-in button inside the app doesn't go through. As soon as I try to submit or refresh (F5), the interface throws a "Connection to the server was lost. Attempting reconnection..." error, and the backend container seems to drop the session or crash.

I've already tried clearing cookies, testing in incognito mode, and re-linking my OAuth connection, but the issue persists.

Is anyone else experiencing this, or could the space backend/OAuth redirect be stuck? Any help would be greatly appreciated so I can get my submission through!

Thanks!
